## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] `composer test` passes, or the omitted check is explained
- [ ] Privacy, immutable-original and no-overwrite boundaries remain intact
- [ ] New evidence uses synthetic data and contains no credentials or private paths
- [ ] Documentation changed only where behaviour or operational guidance changed

## Evidence

Link screenshots, test output or the relevant release evidence when applicable.
